title: TP-MDDN: Task-Preferenced Multi-Demand-Driven Navigation with Autonomous Decision-Making

layout.note: Two lettered sections: (a) Overview holds a tall pink panel at the left and yellow over green panels in the middle, (b) Performance holds one tall blue panel at the right with a scatter plot over a bar chart; each (a) panel is a column of avatars with speech bubbles and boxes.

lesson: Title each overview panel with the question it answers and fill it with a short exchange between a fixed pair of avatars on a real example, so every module reads as one capability; put a results panel with a trade-off scatter plot (gain arrow, Desirable arrow) and a bar chart in the same figure.
